subject.title: Control UI: drag sessions from the sidebar into split view with animated drop preview

question: Should Control UI add sidebar-session drag/drop placement into split view now, and what interaction boundary should the first version support?
rationale: This is a new user-facing DnD workflow on a maintainer-labeled Control UI feature, and automation should not choose the preview/placement/accessibility boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded drag/drop
options.body: Implement sidebar session drag sources plus chat split drop zones for center, right, and down placements, preserving the existing keyboard/select flow and narrow viewport no-op behavior.

options.title: Narrow to replacement only
options.body: Only allow dropping a sidebar session onto an existing pane to replace that pane's session, deferring pane insertion and animated regional previews.

options.title: Defer DnD workflow
options.body: Keep the shipped header-button and pane-selector flow until maintainers decide the extra interaction complexity is worth it.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded drag/drop
recommendation.body: Implement sidebar session drag sources plus chat split drop zones for center, right, and down placements, preserving the existing keyboard/select flow and narrow viewport no-op behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the underlying split-view feature and filed this follow-up workflow request.
